subject: NovaEdge integration — MSA/DPA/SOW consolidation and procurement checkpoints
body:
From: Elena Markov <elena@novaedge.com>
To: vivek@redwood.ai
Cc: procurements@novaedge.com, samir@novaedge.com
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaEdge / Redwood — initial redlines (MSA + DPA + SOW)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We ran the contract through NovaEdge legal and procurement. Attached are our initial redlines for the MSA (track changes), a separate PDF with DPA comments, and an updated SOW with milestone timing. High level asks:

- Limit Redwood liability to direct damages and strike the proposed indemnity broadening.
- Clarify data residency for embeddings and whether KV cache persists beyond session retention.
- Add a 60-day cure period for breach and standard mutual termination for convenience.
- SOW: push integration milestone 2 by two weeks and add a deliverables acceptance checklist.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the security/DPA review vs. commercial redlines? Procurement would like a target signature window of 2–3 weeks to align fiscal planning.

Attachments: NovaEdge_MSA_redlines_v1.docx; NovaEdge_DPA_comments_20260407.pdf; SOW_Integration_v2.docx

Best,
Elena Markov
Head of Legal, NovaEdge

-----

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: marissa@redwood.ai, sergio@redwood.ai, laura@redwood.ai
Cc: elena@novaedge.com
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaEdge / Redwood — initial redlines (MSA + DPA + SOW)

Team — looping you in. Summary of asks from NovaEdge above: liability cap/indemnity, data residency clarity, cure period, timing changes in SOW.

Marissa: can you own procurement cadence and confirm whether we can meet the 2–3 week signature ask?
Sergio: please take commercial redlines and liability/indemnity; we should preserve our standard cap but be prepared to offer a compromise on limiting indemnity carve-outs.
Laura: please run the DPA comments and confirm where we can agree vs need alternate language (particularly around cache persistence and retention).

I'll track and coordinate. If we can consolidate redlines into a single doc and return with annotated compromises, that will speed negotiation.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Partnerships & Integrations
Redwood Inference

-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, sergio@redwood.ai, laura@redwood.ai
Cc: elena@novaedge.com, procurements@novaedge.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaEdge / Redwood — initial redlines (MSA + DPA + SOW)

Thanks Vivek — procurement timeline: we can target a 3-week window to signature but need the following by end of day Monday (4/12):

1) Consolidated redline (one file) with our proposed counter-comments inline.
2) A short commercial summary (1 page) that lists the final proposed price, billing cadence, and PO instructions so their finance team can provision budget.
3) Confirmation whether NovaEdge requires a specific KMS/HSM integration or if standard Redwood-managed KMS is acceptable.

Elena/Procurement — if you can confirm the PO billing entity and whether NovaEdge requires specific invoice fields, that will help.

I'll prepare our procurement checklist and a DocuSign envelope once we have the consolidated doc.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_Integration_v2.docx (referenced)

-----

From: Elena Markov <elena@novaedge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@novaedge.com, samir@novaedge.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaEdge / Redwood — initial redlines (MSA + DPA + SOW)

Marissa, Vivek — thanks, that timeline works. Quick clarifications from our security/legal side:

- Data residency: NovaEdge requires customer data (raw inputs and embeddings) to remain in the account region (US) and prefers a contractual statement that cached KV state will be purged after 30 days unless otherwise agreed. Is that something Redwood can commit to?
- KMS: we prefer a customer-managed KMS option; however, if Redwood can provide a validated attestation and rotate keys on a 90-day cadence, procurement may accept that as interim.
- Liability/Indemnity: procurement flagged the indemnity carveouts as a blocker; they're open to a limited scope tied to negligence and IP infringement but want to avoid broad third-party claims.

We'll upload a short PO template in the next message.

Best,
Elena

-----

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Markov <elena@novaedge.com>, marissa@redwood.ai, sergio@redwood.ai, laura@redwood.ai
Cc: procurements@novaedge.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaEdge / Redwood — initial redlines (MSA + DPA + SOW)

Thanks all — concise next steps and timeline:

1) Laura: please provide a redline-friendly DPA response doc by EOD Monday (4/13) that:
   - Confirms KV cache purge policy options (we can offer 30-day purge as an option with an addendum for longer retention).
   - Outlines KMS options: customer-managed KMS (enterprise add-on) vs Redwood-managed with attestation.
2) Sergio: prepare a commercial compromise note offering a lowered liability cap for NovaEdge (propose 3x fees up to $1M) and a narrowed indemnity tied to IP and gross negligence.
3) Marissa: assemble the consolidated redline (MSA + DPA + SOW) into a single package and prepare the DocuSign envelope. Target return to NovaEdge on Monday 4/13 so procurement can review the week of 4/13–4/17.

Elena: once we send the consolidated package we'll include a short one-pager summarizing final commercial terms and the DocuSign link. If procurement uploads the PO template, we'll confirm required invoice fields before sending for signature.

I'll own the stakeholder sync with NovaEdge and can be available for a quick legal/commercial call Tuesday if needed.

Attachments (to be sent with consolidated package): NovaEdge_MSA_redlines_v1.docx; NovaEdge_DPA_comments_20260407.pdf; SOW_Integration_v2.docx

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Partnerships & Integrations
Redwood Inference
